reviewedFiles.reason: A matched task pair is the aggregation unit; repeated easy runs cannot dominate difficult single attempts. Missing/invalid outcomes remain separate, and small development checks do not support a comparative claim.

Delivery follows the actual caller through wiring and observable behavior. Generated-code inspection and proportionate independent review are separated; a failed first check prompts scoped diagnosis rather than weakened assertions.
A serial thin slice is sufficient when workers are unnecessary. A payload handoff cannot close an authorized integration stage, while another owner's stage remains a legitimate handoff boundary.
Pure transformations avoid invented operation journals; partial-write batches retain per-item outcomes and safe replay. Unknown external outcomes still require reconciliation.

Recovery expands only for a decision-changing gap, and no-match, inaccessible records and stale bytes remain distinct. A compact packet is not represented as restored native history or persisted memory.
Short answers can keep locators inline. Search expansion must address an unresolved claim; stopping search does not establish prior-art absence or turn copies into independent evidence.

Nearest passing control and the first divergent boundary choose a discriminating probe. Repair can cross producer/consumer files within authority; failed interventions update diagnosis rather than repeat blindly.

The ready/held frontier promotes executable progress, checkpoints occur at meaningful boundaries, and input dependencies govern revalidation. Pauses, resource limits, live ownership and unknown-effect rules remain intact.

Missing rationale is separated from observable current state, index failure from actual deletion, and summaries from native history. Unrelated ready work can proceed without reauthorizing uncertain effects.

Predicted observations distinguish live hypotheses; controlled completion order challenges race fixes, and a successful rerun cannot erase intermittent evidence. Mitigation and causal identification remain distinct.
